violations.reason: At step 14 the agent included certificate_8998287 as a payment method for the second booking, but by the time that booking was attempted the certificate was no longer in the user's profile: step 16 returned 'Payment method certificate_8998287 not found', and step 19 confirmed the profile then contained only credit_card_3563913 and gift_card_8516878. This violates the requirement that all payment methods must already be in the user profile.
